inputs.interest_income_note: NOT stripped (ticker rule): Netflix is net debt and reports only a combined 'Interest and other income (expense)' line (9M-2026 $2,946.8M incl. the $2.8B WBD fee; interest income within it $222M 9M-2026). The component build carries no interest income at all, which is the conservative direction.
inputs.sbc_source: 10-Q Q3-2026 cash flow statement: SBC $405.4M 9M-2026 (line 1691) + Q4 run-rate ~$140M = ~$545M FY2026E; taxes paid on net-share settlement $41.0M 9M-2026 (line 1714) + ~$5M Q4 = ~$46M. FY2025 10-K: SBC $368.4M, equity-award taxes $46.2M (kpis).
inputs.buyback_note: 9M-2026 repurchases $10,781.7M (130.3M shares; Q3 alone $4,796.7M / 63.9M shares, a record), $22.3B authorization remaining. Buybacks are value-neutral in this model: SBC is expensed in the flows and the count is held FLAT; the repurchases are what funds the flat count (and more). Prior build shrank the count 2%/yr on top of expensing SBC -- the share-count double-count -- corrected here.
inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted at 2026-09-30: 4,106.3M shares outstanding per the 10-Q cover (post-Q3 buyback) + 60.7M dilutive effect of stock-based awards (Q3-2026 diluted EPS table, line 1878-1879) = 4,167.0M. The Q3 weighted-average diluted count (4,195.1M) is NOT used because it averages in ~64M shares repurchased during the quarter whose cash is already out of the Sep-30 net debt. Held flat (SBC expensed). Post-10:1-split basis throughout.
inputs.price_note: Regular-session close; 52-week range 61.39-116.73, i.e. the price is within 1% of the two-year low. Not an after-hours print.
inputs.net_debt_note: Total debt $15,132.4M (short-term $2,474.8M + long-term $12,657.6M; $993M of new notes issued in Q3) less cash $8,194.3M at 2026-09-30. Short-term investments $28.7M excluded as immaterial. Content liabilities ($3.9B current) are operating, not debt.
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD rate. Rf ~4.3% (10y UST), ERP 5%, beta ~1.1 -> Ke ~9.8%; pre-tax Kd ~5.1% (Q3-2026 $993M notes), ~5% debt weight -> WACC ~9.5%. Unchanged from the prior build. One WACC for all three scenarios (risk is in the driver paths and the weights, charged once); the prior build's 9.0/9.5/11.0 split is unified here and its effect shown in the bridge.
inputs.lease_treatment: Operating leases (~$2.5B liabilities, studios/offices) left inside operating costs; not in net debt. One treatment.
inputs.fy2026_normalization: FY2026E is FY0. Revenue $51.1B = 9M actual $37,684M + Q4 guide $13,400M. Reported FCF: company guide ~$12.0B (cut from ~$12.5B on real-estate transaction timing) INCLUDES the $2.8B WBD termination fee received in Q1-2026 (in OCF via 'Interest and other income'). Normalization: $12.0B - $2.8B fee + ~$0.6B cash tax paid on the fee in Q2-2026 (21% federal + state) + $0.73B non-routine Brazil non-income-tax assessment payments for prior periods (10-Q MD&A, 9M-2026 working capital) = ~$10.5B underlying reported FCF (20.5% of revenue); owner FCF = $10.5B - $0.545B SBC - $0.046B equity-award taxes = ~$9.9B (19.4%). The engine's year-1 flows are UNLEVERED (interest expense ~$0.8B/yr sits in the WACC, net debt deducted once), so the comparable FY2026E engine-basis figure is ~$10.9-11.0B (21.4%); the FY2027 year-1 build lands at ~23.5%, the step being +150bp operating margin, content cash ratio 1.10x -> 1.08x, and the ~30bp FY2026 restructuring charge not repeating.
inputs.ebitda_definition: ebitda_margin_path is ADJUSTED EBITDA = GAAP operating income + PP&E D&A (~0.8% of revenue) + SBC, so that the engine's SBC deduction returns GAAP EBITDA. Content amortization ($16.4B FY2025, $12.8B 9M-2026) stays inside operating costs and is NOT added back; the excess of cash content spend over amortization (FY2026 ~1.10x, ~3.4% of revenue; FY2025 1.08x, 2.85%) is carried inside capex_pct_path alongside PP&E capex (1.9% FY2026E, normalising to 1.5%). wc_capture 2% = deferred-revenue growth net of receivables (FY2025 4.1% of the revenue increase, FY2026 ~0).
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF, component route (operating company, consumer internet; SKILL.md routing row 1). Update of the 2026-08-09 hand-built DCF (no Drivers file then), rebuilt on the engine: same owner-FCF basis and the ticker rules that still hold (post-split basis; WBD fee and its taxes normalized out; growth anchored on revenue CAGR; interest income not stripped; EBITDA = op income + PP&E D&A, content amortization excluded; FY2021+ multiples era). Three deliberate methodology corrections, each priced in reconciliation.bridge: (1) share count held FLAT instead of shrinking 2%/yr while SBC is also expensed; (2) unlevered flows (prior discounted post-interest FCF at WACC and then deducted net debt -- the interest double-count); (3) 10-year horizon because the margin is still ramping at year 5. FY0 rolled from FY2025 to FY2026E (9M actual + Q4 guidance) so year 1 is FY2027; the valuation is effectively as at 31-Dec-2026 against a 30-Sep-2026 balance sheet. Driver years re-judged: FY2027 only (growth -0.5pp base/-1.0pp bull on the ad-target cut and the 11% FX-neutral exit rate; SBC path lifted to ~1.0% after the 2026 step-up). Years FY2028-FY2030 growth and the margin story kept as judged in August; FY2031-36 are new extension years decaying to terminal growth.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: revenue_3yr_and_5yr_cagr FY2022-25 / FY2020-25 (converge at ~12.6%); unchanged, FY2025 is still the last full year
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (5yr 19.2%, 3yr 8.6%) diverges >30% from revenue CAGR (~12.6%) in both directions: the 5yr is inflated by the low pre-buyback FY2020 base, the 3yr suppressed by $21B+ of FY2023-25 buybacks. EPS CAGR (33-36%) embeds margin expansion and count shrinkage. Neither is used; revenue CAGR is the anchor per the ticker rule.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF was negative in FY2018, FY2019 and FY2021 (content build years), so an FCF CAGR is undefined and not used. FY2022->FY2025 owner FCF rose from $1.0B to $9.0B, i.e. the reported FCF growth is NOT being paid for in stock: SBC is ~0.8-1.1% of revenue and buybacks of $9.1B (FY2025) / $10.8B (9M-2026) dwarf it.

base.operating_margin_path_note: GAAP operating margin implied = ebitda_margin - sbc_pct - da_pct: 32.8, 33.8, 34.8, 35.5, 36.2, 36.7, 37.1, 37.4, 37.5, 37.5
base.narrative: Revenue growth decelerates from the FY2026 +13% to +10.5% in FY2027 (Q4-26 guide +12%, +11% FX-neutral; the FY2026 ad-revenue target cut to ~$2.7B and ~+2% view-hours growth shade the near year half a point below the August path) and glides to 3% by FY2036 as the March-2026 price rises lap, the ad tier adds 15 countries in 2027 and live sports/ads sustain ARPU-led growth. GAAP operating margin steps from the 31.5% FY2026 guide (~30bp of restructuring inside it) by ~100-150bp a year to 37.5% by FY2035, slower than the +200bp/yr of FY2024-26 because the ad build-out is behind plan and content (sports rights) inflates. Cash content spend converges from ~1.1x amortization (3.4% of revenue cash drag in FY2026) toward ~1.06x (2.0% of revenue, the steady-state excess for a ~36%-of-revenue amortization base growing 3%) as content growth tracks slower revenue growth; PP&E capex normalises from 1.9% to 1.5%; the cash tax rate ramps from ~17% (FDII/foreign mix) to 22% as those benefits erode; SBC runs at ~1% of revenue after the 2026 step-up. The Paramount-WBD combination trial (March 2027) is a coin-flip the base neither needs blocked nor fears.

bull.operating_margin_path_note: GAAP operating margin implied = ebitda_margin - sbc_pct - da_pct: 33.5, 35.0, 36.5, 37.8, 38.8, 39.6, 40.2, 40.6, 41.0, 41.0
bull.narrative: Ads re-accelerate after the FY2026 rollout miss (2027 expansion to 15 more countries, programmatic marketplace scale) so growth holds 12-12.5% through FY2028, view-hours growth reaccelerates on the record live slate, 2026 price rises stick with the churn response management reports, AI production tooling (InterPositive) cuts content cost so the cash content ratio converges fastest and operating margin reaches 41%, and Paramount-WBD is blocked or materially delayed by the March-2027 trial. Terminal growth 3.5%.

bear.operating_margin_path_note: GAAP operating margin implied = ebitda_margin - sbc_pct - da_pct: 31.5, 32.0, 32.5, 33.0, 33.0, 33.0, 33.0, 33.0, 33.0, 33.0
bear.narrative: The engagement problem is structural: view-hours growth stays ~2% while YouTube's attention share keeps widening, price-rise fatigue lifts churn after the March-2026 increases lap, the ad tier under-monetises, and growth falls to 8% in FY2027 and 2% by FY2035. Operating margin plateaus at 33% because sports rights and guild costs inflate while the Oct-2026 layoffs prove to be the first of several; cash content stays ~1.1x amortization (drag only narrows to ~2.5%), SBC stays ~1%. Paramount-WBD closes mid-2027 and a combined HBO Max/Paramount+/Pluto competes on price. Terminal growth 2%.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Unchanged from August at 25/50/25 (bear above the 15% house default, bull below 35%). Bear 25%: the engagement question is now data-backed (H1-26 view hours +2%, Nielsen YouTube share double Netflix's) and the FY2026 ad target was cut; this is a demand-side structural risk, not solvency, so it does not warrant 35%. Bull 25%: the bull needs three independent things (ad re-acceleration, engagement recovery, Paramount-WBD blocked) and the first just missed its own plan. Base 50%: the business is still growing double digits at a 31.5% margin with record buybacks.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF with SBC expensed and the share count flat; content cash spend above amortization treated as investment (capex), not noise; interest income left unstripped because Netflix is net debt; cash tax ramped to 22%; terminal value the lower of Gordon and 20x. Value is a stream of subscription cash flow whose two live questions are whether attention share (engagement) is eroding structurally and how fast ads monetise.
key_risks_to_valuation: Engagement/attention share: H1-2026 view hours +2%, per-member viewing falling, YouTube's US streaming-TV share ~2x Netflix's -- if structural, the bear growth path is the base
Ad monetisation behind plan (FY2026 ~$2.7B vs ~$3B) and the FY2027 15-country expansion is unproven
Content cost inflation (sports rights, guild costs) keeping cash content above 1.1x amortization -- every 1pp of revenue in that drag is ~$3/share
Paramount Skydance-WBD combination (trial March 2027, no close before June 2027) creating a scaled rival
Disclosure erosion (no subscriber counts, annual engagement reports) leaving third-party data to set the narrative
Terminal value is ~70-80% of EV; a 1pp WACC move is ~$8-10/share (see sensitivity)
